name: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Here are the herbs, adventurer. Take them to Witch Doctor Uzer'i.

Please let him know that I am satisfied with the shrunken head.
narrative.objectives: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This is just what I need to prepare the muisek vessel, adventurer. Soon we will see if my latest incantations prove to be as powerful as I had hoped.

Please, a moment. I must perform the ritual and apply the herbs.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 45 to 50, 29,325 XP in all.

quests.name: A Strange Request
quests.objectiveText: Take the Shrunken Head to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

quests.name: Testing the Vessel
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Hinterlands, and locate the Wildkin.

quests.name: Hippogryph Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.

quests.name: Faerie Dragon Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons.

quests.name: Mountain Giant Muisek
quests.objectiveText: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants.

quests.name: Weapons of Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.
